name: Sendo
author: Per Waagen

sections.description:
Sendo makes B2C and B2B shipping in Norway easy and affordable. With this plugin, you can easily transfer order-data from WooCommerce to Sendo. Sendo is a 100% free online EDI solution. You only pay for the shipping.

Norwegian

Sendo gjør B2C og B2B frakt i Norge enkelt og rimelig. Med denne plugin kan du enkelt overføre ordredata fra WooCommerce til Sendo. Sendo er et 100% gratis nettbasert EDI-system. Du betaler bare for frakten.

NOTE: Sendo requires WooCommerce 5.2 or later.

Short Description

Sendo plugin makes B2C and B2B shipping in Norway easy and affordable.
sections.installation:
Set up takes less than 4 minutes.

  1. Upload the plugin files, or install the Sendo plugin through the WordPress plugins directory.

  2. Activate the Sendo plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress

  3. Use the ‘Menu -> WooCommerce -> setting -> Sendo Ordreintegrasjon’ screen to configure the plugin
